text: 金十数据7月11日讯，7月10日，A股商业航天板块爆发，多只卫星ETF集体大涨。截至收盘，卫星ETF广发、卫星ETF富国、通用航空ETF南方涨幅均超过8%。卫星ETF易方达、卫星ETF鹏华、卫星ETF招商等涨幅超过7%。而根据最新ETF申购数据，资金也在涌入相关主题ETF。Wind数据显示，7月10日，卫星ETF永赢净申购金额达到20.94亿元，卫星ETF富国、卫星ETF易方达、卫星ETF广发等净申购金额也超过3亿元。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 11. On July 10, the A-share commercial aerospace sector surged, with multiple satellite ETFs collectively rallying. By close, satellite ETF (GF), satellite ETF (Fullgoal), and general aviation ETF (Southern) all rose over 8%. Satellite ETF (E Fund), satellite ETF (Penghua), and satellite ETF (China Merchants) gained over 7%. According to the latest ETF subscription data, funds are also flowing into related thematic ETFs. Wind data shows that on July 10, net subscription for satellite ETF (CCB Principal) reached RMB 2.094 billion, while net subscriptions for satellite ETF (Fullgoal), satellite ETF (E Fund), and satellite ETF (GF) also exceeded RMB 300 million.
